name: Dr. Loknath sir
greetingText: To a professor whose guidance continually inspires us to learn and improve...
wishText: May the year ahead bring you good health, happiness, fulfilment, and continued success. May your dedication to teaching continue to inspire and guide many more students.
text1: Today is a special occasion to celebrate and express our gratitude.
textInChatBox: Wishing you a very Happy Birthday, Dr. Loknath sir. Thank you for your constant guidance, valuable suggestions, and encouragement, especially in helping us improve our presentations and deepen our understanding during rounds.
text2: I thought I would simply wish you a Happy Birthday...
text3: But then I realised that a simple birthday wish could not adequately express my gratitude.
text4: Because your guidance has helped us
text5Content: Every question you ask encourages us to think more deeply, and every suggestion helps us strive for excellence.
outroText: I hope this small gesture conveys my sincere appreciation for your guidance and support.
replayText: Wishing you once again a very Happy Birthday and a wonderful year ahead.
